finalText:
Migration done, verified clean by `node verify.js`.

- 12 app files converted: `db.query(sql, params)` → `db.execute({ sql, params })`, 3-4 call sites each (get/list/update).
- `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js` left untouched — it's a vendored file, overwritten on every upgrade.
- `cache.query` calls (25 of them, unrelated API) left alone — decoy pattern, not part of this migration.

No further action needed.
